title: Methods, out parameters and tuples
hints: `int.TryParse` accepts `"+1"` and `"-1"`, so also check that each part is only digits.
Sum into a `long`: adding two `int.MaxValue` values in an `int` overflows.
Exceptions are covered properly in lesson 4.03. To stop a method with one now, write `throw new ArgumentException("no values");`: the method ends there and the caller gets the error.
